references.text: The Levites were given the permanent right to redeem their cities and pasturelands, confirming their special inheritance rights to these areas.
The Levites received no land as an inheritance, but cities to live in and pasturelands for their livestock, as commanded.
Fulfillment of the command to give the Levites cities from the inheritances of the other tribes, including pasturelands around the cities.
Summary of the 48 cities that the Levites received with their associated pasturelands, in accordance with God's command.
List of the Levitical cities given to the various Levitical families from the tribes of Israel.
In Ezekiel's vision of the future land, the Levites are also to receive an area with cities to live in.
The Levites received no land inheritance in Israel, but the Lord was their inheritance, and they were to receive tithes as their portion.
Confirmation that the tribe of Levi should have no inheritance among Israel, but the Lord was their inheritance.
